primer.title: Would you like routine reminders?
primer.description: We’ll only use notifications for the routines you choose to be reminded about.

routine.title: WeCanDay
routine.body: Your planned routine is ready when you are.

granted.title: Reminders are on
granted.description: You can choose reminder times for routines in a later step.

denied.title: Reminders are off
denied.description: That’s okay. You can keep using WeCanDay and change this later in your device settings.
